title: Selectable Local Profiles
objective: Provide a truthful session-only choice between the accepted Professional French transformation and an exact Developer profile, while visibly deferring unsafe semantic simplification and preserving every accepted dictionary, validation, target, insertion, and privacy protection.

included: Add a canonical local catalog for Professional French, Developer, and visibly unavailable Simplified French metadata
Add validated session-only profile selection with Professional French as the launch default
Add deterministic routing to the existing Professional rewriter or an exact Developer pass-through rewriter
Capture an immutable selected-profile snapshot at recording start for the complete dictation
Add a real Profiles page and navigation with truthful current and unavailable states
Update Overview and header copy to disclose the actual rewrite profile separately from the Whisper engine
Add deterministic profile, routing, pipeline, UI-state, cancellation, and regression tests
Produce Release build, complete-suite, focused-review, Judge, and Windows-smoke evidence
excluded: Ollama, local-model installation or download, network, prompts, semantic generation, or new packages
Claiming that Simplified French is operational
Profile persistence, SQLite migration, settings files, registry, or LocalAppData mutation
History, stored text, analytics, telemetry, export, synchronization, cloud, accounts, or secrets
Whisper, audio, hotkey, capsule, Win32, target identity, password, clipboard, insertion policy, Enter, or permission changes
Packaging, deployment, installation, Git commit, push, release, or publication

acceptanceCriteria: Professional French is the default on every launch and retains its accepted deterministic safe output.
Developer is selectable and returns the exact post-dictionary source for ordinary, Unicode, multiline, code, command, URL, path, version, number, and identifier samples.
Simplified French is visible but disabled with an honest local-semantic-engine explanation.
Only canonical catalog-owned available profiles can be selected or routed.
The profile captured at recording start remains fixed until that dictation completes.
Unknown, unavailable, empty, failed, cancelled, or unsafe routing preserves the accepted exact-source fallback semantics.
The Profiles page, navigation, Overview, and header display only real profile state.
Dictionary persistence and every accepted target, password, clipboard, no-Enter, shutdown, and audio-privacy protection remain unchanged.
No selection or user text is persisted or logged and no network, package, Ollama, database, history, or settings mutation is added.
Focused tests pass, the Release solution builds with zero warnings and errors, the complete suite passes, focused reviews have no blocker, and the user Windows smoke passes before closure.
requiredReviews: Focused rewrite architecture and safety review
Focused WPF truthfulness and profile-snapshot review
Focused security, privacy, and test review
User Windows profile-selection smoke before closure
risks: A fabricated profile object could bypass canonical routing.
Changing selection during recording could affect the in-flight dictation.
Developer mode could accidentally normalize technical text.
The UI could imply unavailable semantic simplification or persistence.
The accepted uncommitted MainWindow and rewrite baselines must be preserved.
rollbackPlan: Restore the accepted Professional French profile as the single hard-coded selection.
Remove only Phase 06A profile catalog additions, router, session selection, Profiles page, navigation, tests, and evidence.
Preserve the accepted Phase 05B database and all prior source behavior.
Rebuild and rerun the complete suite after rollback.
dependencies: Accepted deterministic Professional French rewrite and exact fallback service
Existing Profiles navigation placeholder and WPF visual language
Explicit user direction on 2026-07-17 to continue to the next phase
humanApprovals: On 2026-07-17 the user explicitly said `c'est bon phase suivante`, accepting Phase 05B and authorizing preparation of the next bounded phase.
No authorization is inferred for Ollama installation, downloads, persistence changes, history capture, Git publication, deployment, registry, or administrator operations.
